keyframes.prompt: Vertical 2:3 photorealistic landscape photo of a wide green wheat field on gentle rolling hills at sunrise, thin morning mist, warm golden sky, soft sunlight from the low sun on the left. In the center of the frame, a small patch of bare dark brown soil between the young wheat rows. No people, no animals. No text, no watermark.

Edit this image. The camera has moved down to the bare soil patch in the center. Show an extreme macro close-up of moist dark brown crumbly soil, seen from a low side angle. One single plump golden wheat grain lies on the soil in the center of the frame. Warm golden sunrise light from the left, same as before, tiny dew droplets sparkle. Shallow depth of field, blurred green wheat behind. Keep the grain inside the middle 70 percent of the width. No text, no watermark.

Edit this image. Keep the same soil, camera angle and light, but the camera is slightly further back, so the grain looks about 30 percent smaller. The wheat grain has sprouted: thin white roots go into the soil and one slim green wheat shoot grows up from the grain, about 6 times taller than the grain. The grain is still visible at the base. No text, no watermark.

Edit this image. Keep the same warm golden light. The shoot has grown into tall mature wheat plants. The camera now sees their tops: several ripe golden wheat ears with long awns fill the center of the frame, gently bending. Blurred golden wheat field behind. No text, no watermark.

Edit this image. The wheat has been harvested and threshed. Show a top-down view of a round woven bamboo tray filled with a thick layer of plump golden wheat grains, sitting on a rustic wooden surface. A few golden wheat ears lie at the top edge. Same warm golden sunrise light from the left. No text, no watermark.

Edit this image. Keep the same bamboo tray, same top-down camera, same light. The grains are gone: the tray is now filled with soft, fine, pure white wheat flour forming a smooth mound with a small dip in the center. A few golden wheat grains remain at the left edge of the tray. No text, no watermark.

Edit this image. Keep the same top-down camera and the same warm light. Instead of the bamboo tray, show a dark metal baking tray dusted with flour on the rustic wooden surface. On the tray lie three raw, smooth, pale proofed Vietnamese baguette dough loaves, each with one long diagonal slash on top, side by side in the center. No text, no watermark.

Edit this image. Keep the same top-down camera, the same baking tray and the same warm light. The three loaves are now freshly baked Vietnamese baguettes: puffed up, crisp shiny golden-brown crust, the slashes opened into crunchy ridges, a few crust flakes on the tray. No text, no watermark.

Edit this image. Keep the same top-down camera and the same warm light on the same rustic wooden surface. In the center is now one Vietnamese banh mi sandwich on brown paper: a crisp golden baguette split open lengthwise and filled with pate, slices of cold cut pork and roast pork, pickled carrot and daikon, cucumber sticks, fresh cilantro sprigs and thin red chili slices. One loaf of plain baguette lies at the edge. No text, no watermark.

clips.prompt: In a single continuous shot, no scene cuts, no fade, no dissolve. One smooth camera move: the camera quickly and smoothly flies down across the misty wheat field toward the bare soil patch in the center, and glides close to the soil, where one wheat grain lies still. In the final second the camera stops moving. Quiet natural ambience, morning birds, no music, no dialogue.

In a single continuous shot, no scene cuts. Time-lapse. During the whole clip the camera slowly and smoothly pulls back a little, so the wheat grain gets smaller little by little. At the same time the grain slowly sprouts: white roots grow into the soil and a green shoot grows up. Nothing else changes. Quiet nature ambience, no music, no dialogue.

In a single continuous shot, no scene cuts. Time-lapse. The shoot grows bigger and bigger, little by little during the whole clip, into tall wheat plants, while the camera slowly rises with them. Wheat ears appear, ripen and turn golden. Nothing else changes. Soft wind in wheat, no music, no dialogue.

In a single continuous shot, no scene cuts. Golden wheat grains slowly pour down from above into a round bamboo tray, while the camera smoothly tilts down to look straight down at the tray filling up. Nothing else changes. Falling grain sounds, no music, no dialogue.

In a single continuous shot, no scene cuts. Static locked-off camera, no camera movement, no zoom. Time-lapse. The golden wheat grains slowly crumble into fine white flour little by little, in a wave across the tray. The tray stays still. Nothing else changes. Soft grinding sound, no music, no dialogue.

In a single continuous shot, no scene cuts. Static locked-off camera, no camera movement, no zoom. Time-lapse. Hands knead the flour into a smooth dough, the dough rises, and is shaped into three long baguette loaves on a baking tray. Nothing else changes. Soft kneading sounds, no music, no dialogue.

In a single continuous shot, no scene cuts. Static locked-off camera, no camera movement, no zoom. Time-lapse. The three loaves slowly puff up and turn from pale to crisp golden brown, the slashes open into crunchy ridges. The tray stays still. Nothing else changes. Crackling crust sounds, no music, no dialogue.

In a single continuous shot, no scene cuts. Static locked-off camera, no camera movement, no zoom. Hands split one baguette open, spread pate, and fill it with pork slices, pickled carrot and daikon, cucumber, cilantro and chili. Nothing else changes. Crunchy bread sounds, no music, no dialogue.
